verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or agent interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no way to operate Checkout.com through natural-language commands. The 'AI-driven' acceptance optimization is an automated backend feature, and the llms.txt file only helps LLMs read the docs; neither is a natural-language control interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
